title: Cold rebuild: Best stretch
summary: Rebuild Best stretch from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Best stretch** in *Running totals and moving averages*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

code: SELECT day, SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS total
setup: CREATE TABLE daily_revenue (day TEXT, region TEXT, revenue INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (day, region));

steps.title: Rebuild Best stretch cold
prompt: Which **3-day window** had the highest combined revenue (both regions)? Return the **ending_day** of that window and its **total_3d**. Only count complete 3-day windows (skip the first two days).
Tables: `daily_revenue(day, region, revenue)`: one row per day per region (`EU`, `NA`).
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
